text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain finally rises on the Arima 
Kinen. The challenge Fuji Kiseki took on 
has reached its final chapter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst roaring cheers, the Trainer sends 
her off. She tells the Trainer, "I'm so 
glad you were here for me."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she gallantly strides toward the 
race. Fuji Kiseki shone brighter than 
anyone else. She was truly the ultimate 
étoile—
